summary: C06 is implemented, unit-tested, and verified against the Batch C gate: resolve_font rebuilds every fallback candidate with the requested weight, style, and OpenType features via fallback_with_requested_traits in vendor/gpui-pre/src/text_system.rs, cargo check --workspace and cargo check -p gpui-pre exit 0, and all 21 gpui-mcp unit tests pass.

tests.command: cargo test -p gpui-mcp --lib (21 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored)

cargo test -p gpui-pre fallback_tests (scratch copy of this worktree with placeholder bytes at assets/fonts/ibm-plex-sans/IBMPlexSans-Regular.ttf and assets/fonts/lilex/Lilex-Regular.ttf only so the vendored test target can build; the scratch copy was removed and is not part of the deliverable) — text_system::fallback_tests::fallback_replaces_only_the_unavailable_family ok, 1 passed, 0 failed, 338 filtered out

C06-TEXT-FALLBACK-STACK.evidence: vendor/gpui-pre/src/text_system.rs:374-378 rebuilds each fallback candidate with fallback_with_requested_traits (text_system.rs:1343-1358), which keeps the fallback's family and fallbacks but takes the requested Font's weight, style, and OpenType features. The added test text_system::fallback_tests::fallback_replaces_only_the_unavailable_family (text_system.rs:1525-1543) asserts the family is replaced while BOLD weight, Italic style, and non-default OpenType features are preserved; it passes in the scratch run above because the vendored test target itself needs the unvendored assets/fonts paths (upstream Zed tests, not a gate requirement per the verification recipe clarification). cargo check --workspace, cargo check -p gpui-pre, and cargo test -p gpui-mcp --lib all exit 0 on this revision. The task-doc visual acceptance (bold Han fallback at bold weight against 09-language-zh.png) belongs to the Batch D fixtures and is not exercised here.

risks: cargo test -p gpui-pre still cannot compile in-repo because vendor/gpui-pre/src/svg_renderer.rs:361-363 and vendor/gpui-pre/examples/example_support/fonts.rs:10,26 include_bytes! assets/fonts/ibm-plex-sans/IBMPlexSans-Regular.ttf and assets/fonts/lilex/Lilex-Regular.ttf, which the repository has never tracked; per the verification recipe clarification this is not a gate requirement, but Batch D visual-parity fixtures will likely need real font assets.

Fallback text now resolves through the platform's closest face for the requested weight/style instead of the fallback family's regular face, matching the fork's P-D behavior; the change is unit-tested but not visually verified in this batch, so fallback text metrics may differ from the previous regular-face resolution.
